scope: Official New Mexico 2024 SOS President county result rows, President-vs-U.S. Senate precinct review rows, EAC turnout fallback rows, and 2020/2016 official SOS county historical baselines are loaded for staging. Audit, recount, CVR, incident, correction, litigation, state-native turnout replacement, and precinct geometry rows remain source leads only.
repoDrift: docs/developer/index.md is required by AGENTS.md but is missing in this worktree.
displayPathChecked: Staging artifact generation was checked through civic_etl.cli import. Public app/API display would flow through src/app/page.tsx and src/lib/data-access.ts after production promotion, while /api/native-source-packages and /api/source-acquisition-tiers expose planning registries. Production promotion and production API checks were not run from this worker branch.

certifiedResults.caveat: The official SOS API masks small candidate counts with '*'. County masked counts are inferred from SOS percentages and reconcile to the official certified President total.

sameGrainComparisonContest.caveat: President and U.S. Senate precinct keys match after de-duplicating repeated county/precinct/candidate rows. Four zero-vote President precinct keys are skipped by the review importer, yielding 2,165 nonzero review rows. President and Senate precinct totals are each 7 votes below county-level totals after masked-count inference.

stateNativeTurnout.caveat: The SOS page uses eligible voters while the active EAC fallback uses registered voters. Review denominator timing and semantics before replacing EAC turnout.

geometryAndCrosswalk.needed: Collect official voting district or precinct shapefiles from the RGIS clearinghouse and build a result precinct-name crosswalk before subcounty map overlays.
geometryAndCrosswalk.caveat: This branch activates county result rows and precinct review rows, but no New Mexico-specific county or precinct geometry artifact is promoted.

historicalBaselines.caveat: 2020 and 2016 load from official SOS county mapdata API artifacts. The 2012 archive routes to the legacy election statistics hub/PDF path and remains unnormalized.

auditRecountCvrIncidentCorrectionLitigat.caveat: The SOS security page documents risk-limiting audit practice and the 2024 results system reports no possible recounts for the current 2024 General page. No 2024 audit outcome, CVR availability, incident, correction, recount, litigation, custody, or tabulator-log rows are normalized.

remainingRisks: Official SOS precinct review rows require masked-count inference from percentages and de-duplication of repeated county/precinct/candidate rows; review output is public-interest advisory screening context only and not evidence of fraud or misconduct.

After inference and de-duplication, President and U.S. Senate precinct totals are each 7 votes below the corresponding county-level official totals; certified county result rows remain the authoritative result totals.
State-native turnout details are identified, but EAC fallback remains active until eligible-voter denominator semantics and the 367-ballot official-minus-EAC turnout difference are reviewed.
Precinct or voting-district geometry and result-label crosswalks are not loaded.
2012 official historical baseline, normalized audit/CVR/recount/incident/correction/litigation records, custody records, and tabulator-log rows remain source leads or request paths only.
